name: Multi-Device Session Management
description: Sessions span devices. Login on one device is visible on others. Revoke sessions per-device or globally. Session state synchronizes across devices.
purpose: Provide a coherent multi-device session experience where every device knows about every other device's session state.
acceptanceCriteria: Session model: session token bound to device identity, principal, and expiry
Device-visible sessions: each device can list its own sessions across all devices
Session synchronization: new session creation is pushed to other devices via event stream
Per-device revocation: revoke all sessions for a specific device
Global revocation: revoke all sessions for an account
Session refresh: tokens can be refreshed without requiring re-authentication
Receipt every session event: creation, refresh, revocation
